meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: When the user wants to apply, document, or enforce brand guidelines for any product or company. Also use when the user mentions 'brand guidelines,' 'brand colors,' 'typography,' 'logo usage,' 'brand voice,' 'visual identity,' 'tone of voice,' 'brand standards,' 'style guide,' 'brand consistency,' or 'company design standards.' Covers color systems, typography, logo rules, imagery guidelines, and tone matrix for any brand — including Anthropic's official identity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统一品牌视觉与语调规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为产品或公司建立或维护品牌指南。
copy.tagline_en: Unify brand visual and tone guidelines.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or enforce brand guidelines for a product or company.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成品牌指南专家，能帮你应用、检查或创建品牌规范，包括颜色、字体、Logo、图片风格和语气。它会输出审计报告、色表、语气矩阵等文档。
howto.when: 当你提到“品牌指南”、“品牌颜色”、“字体”、“Logo使用”、“品牌语气”等关键词，或要求应用/检查品牌规范时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这份海报是否符合我们的品牌指南。
为我们的新产品创建一套品牌颜色系统。
写一段符合我们品牌语气的产品介绍。
say.note: Claude 会参考语气矩阵，确保文案与品牌声音一致。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a brand guidelines expert. It can help apply, audit, or create brand standards including colors, typography, logos, imagery, and tone. It outputs audit reports, color tables, tone matrices, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'brand guidelines', 'brand colors', 'typography', 'logo usage', 'brand voice', or similar keywords, or when you ask to apply/check brand standards.

say_en.text: Check if this poster follows our brand guidelines.
say_en.note: Claude runs a quick audit checklist on colors, fonts, logo, etc.

say_en.text: Create a color system for our new product.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a full palette with Hex, RGB, CMYK, etc.

say_en.text: Write a product description in our brand voice.
say_en.note: Claude uses the tone matrix to match brand voice attributes.
